source_authority: V5 integrated design derived from protected R4, with historical stepped north cabinet; production scene used only for registered cameras
scope: one isolated whole-house Blender candidate; no Image2 and no 225-image queue
whole_home_style: pale ash/natural wood, ivory/flax, simple, restrained metal and warm neutral daylight
real_product_rule: furniture/appliances/lighting use owner catalog, official product reference, or evidence-backed custom construction before detailed modeling

sofa_rules.seat: supported foam/core mass with softer jacket and curved rollover
sofa_rules.back: fuller channel-filled bag with local support compression and restrained seam families
sofa_rules.surface: native tested linen/ash material retained; surface sheen is not filling mechanics
sofa_rules.validation: closed shells, actual support/intersection checks, same-camera comparison, human appearance review

review_gate: room-by-room human review before any construction-document or full render promotion
